subject: Distance between residues: Too many iteration in routine

messages.author: Hocine EL KHAOUDI ENYOURY
messages.body:
Dear amber community,
I’m trying to determine the distance between 2 residues over time with the following script.
parm protein.psf
trajin protein.dcd
rms first fit .CA
distance abc :4 :19 out distance.dat noimage
Is there any way to define a centre of mass for both residues and track the distance, without having to do it with atoms?
Thanks in advance!
Hocine

messages.author: He, Amy
messages.body:
Hi,
“geom” returns the center of mass (default) of specified atoms – these could be residues if you specify residues, if my understanding is correct.
Are you possibly only interested in the sidechain? Or a certain portion on each residue? In that case you can refine your mask to narrow down the selection of atoms.
